info.name: EduNest API — Auth + Provision + Teacher + Login Resolution + Schedule
info.description:
# RUN ORDER — follow top to bottom on a fresh import

0. Start the backend (`npm run dev` in `backend/`). Set `superEmail`/`superPassword` collection variables from `backend/.env`.
1. `00 Health` → must be ok:true.
2. `01 Auth`: run `01` (saves instituteId), then `04 Login - Super Admin`.
3. `02 Super`: `List Pending` → `Approve Request` (or `Reject Request` for the second school).
4. `01 Auth`: run `05b Login - Admin` — this switches your cookies to the school admin (needed for everything below).
5. `04 Provision`: run `Teachers/Create Teacher` → `Classes/Create Class` FIRST → then `Students/Create Student` (needs classId) → `Settings/Set Terminal Class`.
6. `01 Auth`: run `10 Login - Teacher` (switches cookies to teacher), then use `05 Teacher` + `06` teacher requests.
7. `01 Auth`: run `11 Login - Student` for `06` student requests (`My Attendance`, student timetable).
8. `06`: admin creates timetable → teacher checks `Today Schedule` → teacher `Mark Attendance` → student `My Attendance`.

Cookies: Postman stores the httpOnly session automatically. Re-run the matching login request whenever you switch roles. Test scripts auto-save all IDs/temps into collection variables.

---

# EduNest API — Manual Testing Collection

Covers **all currently implemented routes** (`backend/src/app.ts`):

- `GET /api/health`
- `POST /api/auth/admin-request`, `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/refresh`, `/api/auth/logout`, `GET /api/auth/me`
- `GET /api/super/requests`, `POST /api/super/requests/:id/approve`, `POST /api/super/requests/:id/reject`
- `POST /api/super/institutes`, `GET /api/super/institutes`, `GET /api/super/institutes/:id`, `PATCH /api/super/institutes/:id/status`

Public (rate-limited: 10/min portal, 5/min console via X-Client). Body identifier = email OR loginId. Sets httpOnly cookies `edunest_token` (15min) + `edunest_refresh` (7d). Update `superEmail/superPassword` collection variables from your backend/.env first.

THE request to run after your school is active (via Approve Request or Direct Create). Uses {{adminEmail}} / {{adminPassword}} — prefilled for the Sunrise approve-flow; auto-saved by Direct Create. Sets the admin cookies needed for 04 Provision. X-Client: console.
Negative test: valid identifier + wrong password → 401 'Invalid credentials' (generic, no user enumeration).

Auth required (cookie). Returns `{ user, banner: { adminSuspended, instituteStatus } }`. Super-admin gets `instituteStatus: 'none'`. No status gate here by design so frontends can render pending/suspended banners.
Auth via refresh cookie. Reads `edunest_refresh`, rotates it, re-sets both cookies, returns `{ user }`. Old refresh token is invalidated (reuse → 401). Works even if access token expired.
Clears both cookies + revokes stored refresh hash server-side. Run LAST — after this, Super requests return 401 until you re-login (04).

Teacher login = SAME /auth/login endpoint. identifier = T-XXXX loginId (auto-saved by 04 Provision / Create Teacher), password = one-time temp. Sets teacher cookies — run this before the 05 Teacher folder.

item.name: 02 Super - Approval Queue
item.description: All require super-admin cookie (login 04 first). `protect → allowRoles(super-admin) → checkStatus`.

request.description: Default queue view. `GET /api/super/requests?status=pending`. Shows institute + requesting admin profile only — no student/teacher data.
Already-approved queue. `?status=active`. After approving, your Sunrise row moves here.
Rejected queue. Note: rejected = institute stays pending + admin=rejected (record preserved), filtered on admin row.
Sets Institute=active + Admin=active, writes AuditLog. Idempotent (re-approve → same 200). Uses `{{instituteId}}` auto-saved from Auth/01. Replace `:id` with a real ObjectId from the pending list.
Body `{ reason (min 3 chars) }`. Only pending can be rejected. Already-approved → 400 'use block-admin instead'. Uses `{{rejectInstituteId}}` auto-saved from Auth/02.
Negative test: malformed ObjectId → 400 'Invalid id format' (not 500). Unknown-but-valid ObjectId → 404.

item.name: 06 Schedule & Attendance
item.description:
PREREQUISITES — run these first (top to bottom), otherwise IDs are empty and every request fails:
1. `01 Auth → 05b Login - Admin` (admin cookies).
2. `04 Provision → Teachers → Create Teacher` (saves teacherId, teacherLoginId, teacherTempPassword, teacherPhone).
3. `04 Provision → Classes → Create Class`, then `Assign Teacher` with the teacher above (saves classId).
4. `04 Provision → Students → Create Student` in that class (saves studentId, studentLoginId, studentTempPassword).
5. `01 Auth → 10 Login - Teacher` before teacher requests; `11 Login - Student` before student requests.
Then run this folder top to bottom: Timetable → Today Schedule → Class Info → Attendance.

Timetable + today-schedule + class-info + attendance. Flow: admin creates timetable → teacher checks today-schedule → teacher marks attendance → student views own attendance.
